name: Escape From Nova VR
summary:
Stranded and alone aboard the Nova 9 space station orbiting Mars, you are the last surviving crew member. A once-thriving station is now a silent, eerie labyrinth filled with secrets. As the sole hope for survival, you must navigate through the desolate halls and solve intricate puzzles to unlock new areas.
